output.quotable_sentence: In 2025, 21.7% {R} of decisioned FHA applications were denied, out of 1,217,297 applications that reached a credit decision. Source: FinanceRateCalc analysis of the public CFPB HMDA 2025 record; historical aggregate, not a prediction about any application.

In 2025, in every US state with a published loan-size split, FHA applications under $150,000 were denied more often than loans over $250,000; the small-loan penalty ranged from about 1.3x to 3.19x (ID, 38.3% vs 12.0%). {R} Source: FinanceRateCalc analysis of the public CFPB HMDA 2025 record.
In 2025, 14.8% {R} of decisioned FHA applications in ID were denied, against 21.7% nationally. Source: FinanceRateCalc analysis of the public CFPB HMDA 2025 record.

Across the 100 largest FHA lenders in 2025, the reason with the highest median share was dti at 40.8% of cited reasons; "application incomplete" had a median share of 1.2% but reached 73.5% at Carrington Mortgage Services LLC. Reason fields are not a partition. {R} Source: FinanceRateCalc analysis of the public CFPB HMDA 2025 record.

In 2025, among FHA lenders with at least 100 decisioned applications in Cleveland, OH metro (MSA 17410), lender-level denial rates ranged from 6.3% to 80.1%, a gap of 73.8 percentage points inside the same federal program. {R} Source: FinanceRateCalc analysis of the public CFPB HMDA 2025 record.
